premise.claim: Setting only imageTag in a component runtimeVersion is silently ignored: the AdvancedStatefulSet is not patched, pods keep the old image, no error/event/condition (issue #6178)
premise.reportedComponent: pkg/ddc/cache (CacheRuntime engine sync + transform paths, AdvancedStatefulSetManager.updateImage)
premise.evidence: On base, P0a/P0b fail with observed image fluid/cache:v1 (edit dropped) on both the update and create paths; the repo's own composition-matrix row pins the same behavior with knownBug #6178. Both pass on the PR head. results/base-harness.txt, results/pr-head-harness.txt
match: P0a [contract vs base]: update path applies an imageTag-only version
P0b [contract vs base]: create path applies an imageTag-only version
F1a [contract]: a digest image's missing tag stays incomplete
F1b [contract]: the update path never lands an invalid digest:tag reference
F1c [contract]: the create path never renders an invalid digest:tag reference
F2 [canary]: an empty-version worker follows the edited class template image
